profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company traded under the ticker CDNS, with CIK 0000813672, headquartered in San Jose, California. On its own site the company describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider delivering hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The same site material describes Cadence as being about "being a great company," citing Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work and an investment in sustainability.

The site's framing of "Intelligent System Design" is the closest thing to an AI position in the available material. No specific AI products, models, or tools are named in the text reviewed, and no products are listed among the facts held on the company.

On the record-keeping side, the company's law exposure is recorded for California, with a count of 281. No individual cases are listed, and no MCP servers are recorded for Cadence.
